entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I, uh, I need to make a return. I'm just so disappointed about it.
I'm certainly sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF98765. It's for the Aero Race jersey I just received.
Okay, I see that order right here. It looks like it was delivered two days ago. To understand the best way to help, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey?

It's just... it's the wrong size. I measured myself and everything, but it's just way too tight across the shoulders. I've been a loyal customer for so long and I saved up for this. I feel so silly and I really needed this to work out.

I completely understand. Getting the perfect fit with performance apparel can be tricky. Since it sounds like a sizing preference and not a technical fault, we have a couple of great options for you. Would you prefer to exchange it for a larger size, or would you like to process a full return?
You can do a return? For a full refund? I was so worried I'd be stuck with it, and I really needed that money back if it wasn't going to fit. Are you sure?

Absolutely. Our jerseys and other apparel have a 90-day return policy, so you are well within the window. We want to make sure you have gear that you love and that fits you perfectly. Getting you a refund because it was the wrong size is no problem at all.
Oh, that's such a relief! I was so stressed about this. So I can just send the too tight one back?

That's correct. I am generating a prepaid return label for you right now, and I'll email it to the address on file. You can simply pack the jersey up and drop it at the post office. We can also process an exchange right now if you'd like to get the next size up on its way.
Thank you so much. Let's just do the return for now. You've been so helpful, Alex. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome. The email with the return label has just been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
